Hello everyone!

It is with great pleasure I can announce the UZD2 demo is now available to play throughout Steam's NEXT FEST!

notes.title: HIGH SCORE RESET & ASUS AURA READY
notes.notes:
Hello zombie slayers!

In today's update we are completely refreshing the high scores, and by doing so are getting rid of a number of cheating players sitting on the top spots. So go now and earn the top spot!

Also in today's update we've added support for ASUS Aura Sync devices. With ASUS AURA, you'll be able to sync the backlight of supported hardware devices to events happening in the game! For example, when recovering health, your supported hardware will react to your actions and glow green. Now the battles will become brighter and more spectacular!

To use ASUS Aura, you'll need to have the latest Armoury Crate installed on your system. For more info, visit: 
https://rog.asus.com/forum/showthread.php?120213-Install-Armoury-Crate-amp-Enable-In-Game-Effects-for-Supported-Games&p=813225#post813225

notes.title: New defences, content & more 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have been working hard to include some of the things you want the most, and we are pleased to introduce some of new defences:

TESLA TOWER

This high powered tower can target multiple enemies and will release an electrical burst of energy, destroying anything in it's path. You may place up to 6 of these at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/59c0027ef2c1dbe90f159b93d0ea67bf04addd7a.png[/img]

WOODEN FORTIFICATIONS 

Two new wooden defences make their way into UZD today. They both deal damage to attacking enemies, and come in sizes 1x1 & 2x2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/b78f7a5ccb3c561f5568e5b2d49126d58f49cd68.png[/img]

TERMINATOR TOWER

Get ready to blow a hole in the infected. A super charged version of the TESLA TOWER is the TERMINATOR TOWER. Only 1 may be used at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/a529ce2d961999af496e7c7c68d1bc193594f0cd.png[/img]

IN OTHER NEWS

- We have adjusted the health and cost of other buildings to balance the wooden defences
- Limited the number of HESCO barriers that can be placed to 80
- Limited the number of electric grids/traps that can be placed to 50
- Updated Chinese translations (thanks to Minstuk)
- Updated Turkish translations (thanks to Mr.Ares)

COMING SOON

- Laser fences

Let us know in the comments what you think!
Thank you everyone

Terror Dog team

notes.title: Public Test beta & Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

From now on we will introduce new updates a little earlier on a beta branch. For those of you who wish to access the new content faster all you need to do is:

- Right click the game in your library and select properties
- Navigate to the beta tab
- Select the public-test branch 

This will set your game to the latest available version. To go back to the default simply opt out of all betas. Note that multiplayer only works for players on the same game version.

New changes available on public-test:

- Bug with turret reloading fixed
- Engineer drone turret lasers range reduced
- Large icon bug for players who join in progress fixed
- Witch enemy had a bug where the camera shake did not work, fixed
- Fixed a bug if the player died whilst on a gun turret they would re-spawn and not be able to move
- Fixed a bug where the engineer drone was not visible to everyone in some circumstances
- Performance increases on client side players

Thank you!

Keep slay'n!

- Soupex boss has less health, and deals less damage in all forms

- Cash modifier on easy has been increased from 1.25x to 1.5x

notes.title: New Map: The Bridge
notes.notes:
Welcome the new map: The Bridge!

"MANY TRIED TO FLEE THE CITY WHEN THE GOVERNMENT WENT TO SHIT - BUT IT WAS TOO DAMN LATE. THE ONLY WAY IN AND OUT OF THE CITY IS BY THE BRIDGE ... AND NOT EVERYONE MADE IT OUT."

Zombies will swarm in both sides of the bridge, giving you fewer places to run to, so you may want to set up a strong defensive line and hold your ground!

In other news:

- Fixed zombies getting stuck in some of the city map spawn locations
- Automatic sentry health has received a 25% health buff
- Fixed a bug with Land mines where they did no damage or appear to explode

Have fun!

Bridge map almost ready to release

notes.title: Patch notes 0.9.1

notes.title: Patch notes 0.9.0
notes.notes:
The recent release of the multiplayer beta came with it a bunch of issues that a lot of you have been helping identify on our discord server, so thanks for that!

Here's what we've added in this update:

- In-game chat. Simply press 'T' or 'Y' to open the chat interface.
- Fixed a bug where boss zombies could appear under the map.
- Player has joined/left the lobby message in chat box
- Fixed the double stacked buildings bug
- Fixed a bug where the screaming zombie's shaking effect would also affect other players 
- Fixed a repair bug where sometimes a building would appear to need fixed when it was full health
- Kill count on the score tab is now fixed and will record each player's performance
- Player names have been added next to their health bar 
- Increased zombie health for each additional player in your party
- Fixed a bug where the garden fences would not spawn in
- Fixed a bug where the host's character model would apply for everyone
- Implemented steam invites
- Added an invitation UI pop-up where you can notify/get notified to join a game
- Some minor performance increases
- Other various fixes

We'll continue improving the performance of the game during multiplayer sessions & push out updates at any given opportunity.

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER beta
notes.notes:
Multiplayer has arrived!

At long last you will be able to join other players in laying waste to the undead!

We have opened the host game & browse server options from the main menu. For the moment, joining a game currently in progress is disabled, so you'll have to be in the team from the starting lobby. We'll be working to enable that alongside fixing the remaining issues with multiplayer and continue to refine the experience.

So here we are:

- Multiplayer servers open (beta)
- Music library updated with 12 more awesome tracks
- Draw distance graphics setting is now available
- Fixed a shadows issue (illusion of floating characters)

We'll be pushing an update out in the next few days that will enable text chat in-game to help teams communicate better.

Look forward to playing with you all!

notes.title: Patch notes 0.8.0
notes.notes:
This week we have been progressing with multiplayer and started design on an additional map.

We have had several issues pop-up on our radar we have fixed in the meantime:

- Electric grids are now dragable when placing
- Laser clipping bug fixed.
- Barbed wire sound bug fixed. 
- Weapon reload issue fixed where shotguns/grenade launcher weapons were causing a non-reload related issue

notes.title: Electric Grid Fix
notes.notes:
Thanks to all on discord who pointed out the issue.

Electric fences should now work as expected.

notes.title: Patch notes 0.7.5
notes.notes:
This week, we have added some satisfying destruction feedback to the game.

Your defences will now crumble to pieces once destroyed, instead of just disappear:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/86aaf6821371b4b7253532aad1c0baacf7859751.gif[/img]

Sentries are now more efficient, and will attack the next closest enemy, making them much more powerful than before.

Other than that we've balanced the electric grid, by decreasing the amount of time it will stay active, as well as fix a few minor bugs.

Multiplayer is still on track for the end of the month, will let you all know more nearer the time!
